tools.name: search_cards
tools.description:
Find cards or sealed products by name (e.g. "charizard ex 199/165"). Returns
    product_id, name, set, number, latest market price and the page URL. `game` is
    one of pokemon, one-piece, lorcana, riftbound, gundam; omit for every game.

tools.name: card_price
tools.description:
Today's price for one product: market price per printing (Normal, Holofoil,
    Reverse Holofoil...), the lowest listing, the date, and the page URL.

tools.name: price_history
tools.description:
Daily market price history per printing for the last `days` days (max 1000;
    history starts February 2024). Use it for trend questions: up or down, since when.

tools.name: most_valuable
tools.description:
The most valuable cards right now for a game (raw near-mint TCGplayer market),
    plus the highest PSA 10 floors. Games: pokemon, one-piece, lorcana, riftbound, gundam.

tools.name: movers
tools.description: Biggest price gainers and losers over `days` (1 to 90) for a game, cards over $5.

tools.name: all_time_highs
tools.description: Cards that set an all-time high in the last 7 days and still hold it.

tools.name: all_time_lows
tools.description: Cards worth $5+ sitting at their all-time low after falling at least half from their high.

tools.name: sealed_prices
tools.description: Booster boxes, elite trainer boxes, bundles, packs and tins priced today, by kind.

tools.name: set_prices
tools.description:
Every card in a set with today's price, the most valuable cards, and the set's
    total market value. Set ids come from search results (group_id).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search TickerMint for cards and sealed products. Returns ids for `fetch`.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one product by id: today's prices per printing, 30 and 90 day moves, page URL.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
